name: wisdom-garden
description: Knowledge is planted, cultivated, and harvested — not created, stored, and retrieved. Compress session context into lasting memory, reflect on patterns as seeds, and elevate proven seeds into reusable skills.

memory_root.title: Memory repo folder (mod)
memory_root.description: Mod only: the memory repo's root folder, the one that holds compressions/ and MEMORY.md. The seed files are read from its memory/ folder when that holds MEMORY.md, else from the root. Empty tries ~/TresPies-AI-Orchestration, then ~/.hermes/orchestration/trespies-memory.

stale_days.title: Stale after days (mod)
stale_days.description: Mod only: a memory read counts as stale when its verified (else updated) date is older than this. 0 turns the age check off; valid_until and superseded still count.

weekly_toast.title: Weekly score (mod)
weekly_toast.description: Mod only: at the first session of each new week, compute the score, save the week and show a toast pointing at /garden-score.
